key.name: assistant-enabled
key.summary: Enable the Lemonade AI assistant in the overlay search

key.name: lemonade-model
key.summary: Model the embedded Lemonade server uses for the assistant
key.description: The embedded server listens on 127.0.0.1:13345 by default (not Lemonade's usual 13305). Override the port by writing UMOJA_LEMONADE_PORT=PORT to ~/.config/umoja/lemonade.env.

key.name: assistant-backend
key.summary: Where the assistant's chat model runs
key.description: 'local' uses the embedded Lemonade server and lemonade-model. 'cloud' sends assistant requests to the OpenAI-compatible endpoint in cloud-base-url using cloud-model. The API key is kept in the keyring, never in GSettings. File search embeddings always stay local.

key.name: cloud-base-url
key.summary: Base URL of the OpenAI-compatible cloud endpoint

key.name: cloud-model
key.summary: Model name requested from the cloud endpoint

key.name: file-search-enabled
key.summary: Index the home folder so files can be found by what they're about
key.description: umoja-files keeps a local index in ~/.cache/umoja/files. Hidden folders, .gitignore'd paths and folders holding .nomedia, .trackerignore or CACHEDIR.TAG are left out. Content is embedded only on mains power, by the embedded Lemonade server.

key.name: file-search-embedding-model
key.summary: Lemonade embedding model used for file search
key.description: Downloaded through the embedded Lemonade server on an unmetered connection. Changing it re-embeds the index.

key.name: dictation-hotkey
key.summary: Extra shortcut to toggle Myna voice dictation
key.description: Myna Settings binds Myna's own shortcut (Super+J by default) as a GNOME custom shortcut, which Umoja honours; this key is only an additional one.

key.name: ask-about-screen-hotkey
key.summary: Ask the assistant about the selected text or the current window

key.name: copy-text-hotkey
key.summary: Copy the text in a screen area
key.description: Opens the screenshot UI in Copy Text mode: drag out an area and its text is read with Tesseract OCR and put on the clipboard.

key.name: clipboard-history
key.description: Remember text copied this session (in memory only, never on disk) so the overlay can offer it again with translate, reformat and summarize actions. Text that password managers mark as secret is never recorded.

key.name: tile-top-left
key.summary: Tile window to the top-left quarter

key.name: tile-top-right
key.summary: Tile window to the top-right quarter

key.name: tile-bottom-left
key.summary: Tile window to the bottom-left quarter

key.name: tile-bottom-right
key.summary: Tile window to the bottom-right quarter
